verdict.rationale: Resuming a crashed crawl from a checkpoint is a fair reliability question for a browser-automation and scraping platform, so the axis applies. The pack shows no crawl checkpointing or crash-resume capability. The closest item, pauseWhen [browserbase-docs-23], is a deliberate human-in-the-loop pause that resumes after the user replies; it is not recovery of a crashed deep crawl from saved state, so it is not credited.
